from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
source = root / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md'
diff = root / 'director-referral-candidate.diff'
candidate = root / 'director-referral-candidate.json'
readme = source.read_text()
patch = diff.read_text()
assert 'Send in a pull request' in readme
additions = [line[1:] for line in patch.splitlines() if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++')]
assert len(additions) == 1 and 'globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev' in additions[0]
assert 'sqliteproof' in readme and 'silentdrop' in readme
assert json.loads(candidate.read_text())
with __import__('tempfile').TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    work = Path(folder)
    (work / 'README.md').write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--check', str(diff.resolve())], cwd=work, check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', str(diff.resolve())], cwd=work, check=True)
    changed = (work / 'README.md').read_text().splitlines()
    assert changed.count(additions[0]) == 1
    index = changed.index(additions[0])
    assert '## Misc' in changed[:index]
    del changed[index]
    assert changed == readme.splitlines()
url = 'https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/'
